title: Global Jurisdiction System Profiles
build_status: Complete locally — external and owner-controlled decisions held
summary: Publish twenty jurisdiction-level system-reading profiles that expose authority topology, evidence contracts, open acquisition slots, and non-equivalence boundaries without claiming artifact review or jurisdictional performance.
record_scope: Append-only Phase 190 global-reference content layer over the Phase 116–180 evidence and operating corpus.
publication_boundaries: Prepared content and evidence-control architecture only. A mapped authority, source portal, acquisition slot, question, or review packet does not establish an external fact, project stage, accepted service, compatible series, comparison result, score, rank, translation approval, expert approval, or publication decision.
An institutional home page is an authority-discovery rail, not an exact artifact and not evidence for a downstream claim.
Unknown, unavailable, not-yet-reviewed, and incompatible are preserved as distinct states; no unsuccessful search is treated as proof of nonexistence.

jurisdiction_system_profiles.title: Canada system-evidence profile
jurisdiction_system_profiles.profile_state: Published discovery architecture — no downstream findings

authority_topology.evidence_role: Discovery entry point for official statistical release, time series, methodology and revision note.
Discovery entry point for system plan or rule, operating data, capacity or reliability report.
Discovery entry point for project or assessment register, permit or authorization, delivery, completion or acceptance record.

authority_topology.institution_name: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
authority_topology.evidence_role: Discovery entry point for research program or award, technical report, standard, trial or adoption record.

system_reading.scope: Read Canada through separate official statistics, energy or system-operation, territorial delivery, and science or industrial-innovation rails where those classes are mapped.
system_reading.governance_question: Which body has authority over the exact decision, measurement, permit, funding instrument, operating record, or revision being cited?
system_reading.delivery_question: What named entity and conversion stage does the artifact actually support, and where does that support stop?
system_reading.outcome_question: Is there a repeated observation with stable identity, period, definition, method, unit, denominator, and revision treatment?
system_reading.comparison_question: Which definitions in Canada can be matched to another jurisdiction without erasing statutory, geographic, methodological, or institutional differences?
